summary: Regression retest after iteration_58 fixes. Both previously-reported blockers are CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) serve.json redirects for /, /index.html, /tr, /tr/, /en, /en/ are present and resolve directly to /tr/index.html or /en/index.html (no more directory listing), and the build script's routing() now regenerates them so a rebuild preserves them; (2) absolute_assets() rewrite is complete — url() in inline style attributes, './media' literals in <script> blocks and srcset entries are all now root-absolute, and the three affected JS files (materials3d.js, ew-plans-data.js, news.js) use /media/... base paths. Verified via: pytest static_pages suite 98/98 passing, a browser sweep across 27 URLs including every routing redirect returning ZERO 4xx/5xx responses, and per-page broken-image audits on /tr/index.html, /tr/the-apartments-ana.html (82 nearby tiles, 13 with inline bg urls — the exact 13 that were previously blank — all load), /en/the-apartments-ana.html, /tr/tasarim.html, /en/design.html → 0 broken images on every page. Hero video upgrade confirmed: MP4 <source> element src is rewritten to /media/videos/hero-nova-1600.mp4 on 1920px viewport. Interactive features: East-West plan tabs EAST/WEST and the duplex layout tabs toggle class.active correctly; projects filter buttons on /tr/projeler.html respond; 3D materials carousel on /tr/tasarim.html has 14 swatches, a canvas, 5 named material tabs (walnut/stone/bronze/leather/glass) and prev/next controls — tab + next clicks succeed after scroll-into-view. News feed loads 41 cards on both /tr/medya.html and /en/newsroom.html with no broken news images (fallback cover resolves). Language switcher preserves page context on all 8 verified pairs (muhendislik↔construction, santiye-muduru-mimar↔construction-site-manager-architect, bildirim↔speak-up, aday-aydinlatma-metni↔applicant-privacy-notice, tasarim↔design, projeler↔projects, the-apartments-ana↔the-apartments-ana, medya↔newsroom). Mobile 390×844 on /tr/index.html: 0px horizontal overflow, cookie banner readable in Turkish and dismissable via 'ANLADIM', side-menu .lang-switch--menu EN link present with href /en/index.html (context-preserving).

issues: Side-menu lang-switch tap targets are 33.6×16.5 px — below the WCAG 2.5.5 44×44 CSS-px recommendation. They are visible and work, but a user with large fingers may mis-tap. Low-priority accessibility nit.

verified_regressions: serve.json routing: /, /index.html, /tr, /tr/, /en, /en/ all 301 → /tr/index.html or /en/index.html (final 200, correct html lang).
No 4xx asset requests on /tr/index.html, /en/index.html, /tr/the-apartments-ana.html, /en/the-apartments-ana.html, /tr/tasarim.html, /en/design.html (0 broken , 0 relative-path backgrounds).
13 Ana nearby-landmark tiles now have resolved inline-bg urls.
3D material swatches (walnut/stone/bronze/leather/glass) render on both /tr/tasarim.html and /en/design.html.
Hero MP4 source upgraded to /media/videos/hero-nova-1600.mp4 at 1920px viewport.
News feed loads 41 TR cards from /tr/medya.html and 41 EN cards from /en/newsroom.html, fallback cover resolves to root-absolute path.
Language switcher keeps page context on 8/8 verified page pairs (both directions).
No horizontal overflow and cookie banner dismissable on mobile /tr/index.html.
critical_code_review_comments: build_i18n.py now covers the previously-missed asset reference styles (url() in inline style, './media' in <script>, srcset lists) and emits the full redirect set in routing(). The patch is complete and the headless sweep observed zero regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 98/98 pytest, 27/27 pages with zero 4xx, all iteration_58 regressions resolved, all interactive flows exercised succeed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both previously-reported blockers (routing to directory listing, and relative ./media paths in inline style/scripts) are fixed and verified. Next regression run can focus on content changes rather than infrastructure. Note the only observation left is a mobile side-menu lang-switch tap-target size which is below WCAG 2.5.5 (33.6×16.5 CSS px) — not a functional defect, treat as low-priority accessibility polish. Do NOT flag protected English brand/project names on Turkish pages, 'home office' on finance-nova, or stub forms never showing success — per the agent-to-agent context note those are intentional.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a verification pass; both root causes identified in iteration_58 (serve.json redirect gap for /tr, /tr/, /en, /en/ with trailingSlash:false; absolute_assets regex not touching url()-in-style and './media' JS literals) are confirmed fixed in /app/scripts/build_i18n.py routing() and absolute_assets() respectively, and the rebuild propagated the fixes to all 66 output pages.
